title: Carne Asada Tacos
description: A classic Mexican dish, Carne Asada Tacos are a staple of taco trucks and restaurants everywhere. Thinly sliced grilled steak, served with fresh toppings and warm tortillas, is a flavor combination that's hard to beat.
instructions: Season flank steak with salt and pepper.
Grill steak for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired level of doneness.
Transfer steak to a cutting board and let rest for 5 minutes.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
Warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble tacos by placing sliced steak onto a tortilla, followed by a sprinkle of cilantro, a squeeze of lime juice, and a sprinkle of onion.
